output.answer_markdown: Amcor primarily operates in the packaging industry. It develops and produces responsible packaging (flexible and rigid packaging, specialty cartons, closures) for food, beverage, pharmaceutical, medical, home and personal-care, and other consumer goods end markets [7][4].

provenance.quote: Amcor is a global leader in developing and producing responsible packaging for food, beverage, pharmaceutical, medical, home and personal-care, and other products.

claims.text: Amcor is a global leader in developing and producing responsible packaging, i.e., it primarily operates in the packaging industry.

provenance.quote: through a range of flexible and rigid packaging, specialty cartons, closures, and services

claims.text: Amcor's products include flexible and rigid packaging, specialty cartons, closures, and services.

provenance.quote: The Company's business activities are organized around two reportable segments, Flexibles and Rigid Packaging.

claims.text: Amcor's business is organized around two reportable segments, Flexibles and Rigid Packaging.
